scientific_integrity: Analytic finite-dimensional identity and a sharp counterexample; independent validation not performed. Numerical checks are supplementary and do not prove the continuum quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns exact full-length two-state Markov subflows, independent random choice of their order, and Euclidean squared probability-vector error. The exhibited three-state pair blocks a universal extension but does not rule out exact mixtures for special larger pairs. Publication-priority comparisons are not exhaustive.
title: Universal exact-mean random Lie order for two-state Markov generators, with a sharp three-state obstruction
